textes.Bienvenue à La Meule d’Or, une fromageri: Welcome to La Meule d’Or, an artisan cheese shop in Paris that also ships its cheeses all over Europe. Cheeses, producers, milks, ripening, batches and sales: all its data is here. You help its team: Margot, the manager, Julie at the counter, Paul for the tastings, Baptiste, the cheese ager, and Nadège for loyalty. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par producteur (ferme, fromage: One row per producer (farm, cheesemaker, dairy) whose cheeses the shop sells, with its region, its country and the date it was founded.
textes.Une ligne par lait utilisé pour fabrique: One row per milk used to make the cheeses: the animal it comes from and its origin, farmhouse or industrial.
textes.Une ligne par fromage du catalogue, avec: One row per cheese in the catalog, with its producer, its milk, its texture, its price per kilo and whether it’s available. A cheese can have several batches, or none.
textes.Une ligne par affinage : le passage en c: One row per ripening: a cheese’s time in the cellar, with its duration, the temperature, the humidity and its dates. Several batches of the same cheese can share the same ripening.
textes.Une ligne par lot fabriqué d’un fromage,: One row per batch of a cheese made, with its weight, its production date, its unique number and, if it went into the cellar, its ripening.
textes.Une ligne par client qui a un compte, qu: One row per customer with an account, whether or not they’ve bought anything yet. Customers come from several European countries; only their city is recorded.
textes.Une ligne par vente : une quantité prise: One row per sale: a quantity taken from a single batch, sold on a given day to a customer with an account or at the counter without one, with the amount paid.
textes.Une ligne par dégustation en boutique :: One row per in-store tasting: a customer with an account tastes a cheese and gives it a rating, with or without a comment.
textes.Nom du producteur (ex. « Ferme des Alpes: Name of the producer (e.g. “Ferme des Alpes”).
textes.Date de création de l’exploitation, au f: Date the business was founded, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Animal dont vient le lait : « Vache », «: Animal the milk comes from: “Cow”, “Goat”, “Sheep” or “Buffalo”.
textes.Nom du fromage (ex. « Beaufort », « Pont: Name of the cheese (e.g. “Beaufort”, “Pont-l'Évêque”, written with a straight apostrophe).
The producer who makes the cheese.
textes.Le lait utilisé pour fabriquer le fromag: The milk used to make the cheese.
Selling price per kilo, in euros.
textes.1 si le fromage est proposé à la vente,: 1 if the cheese is for sale, 0 otherwise.
textes.Durée de l’affinage, en jours ; pour un: Duration of the ripening, in days; for a ripening still in progress, it’s the planned duration.
textes.Date d’entrée en cave, au format AAAA-MM: Date it went into the cellar, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Date de sortie de cave (AAAA-MM-JJ) ; vi: Date it came out of the cellar (YYYY-MM-DD); empty (NULL) if the ripening is still in progress.
textes.L’affinage suivi par le lot ; vide (NULL: The ripening the batch went through; empty (NULL) if the batch didn’t go into the cellar.
textes.Poids du lot à sa production, en kilos (: Weight of the batch when produced, in kilos (sales don’t reduce it).
textes.Date de production du lot, au format AAA: Production date of the batch, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Numéro unique du lot : code du fromage,: Unique batch number: cheese code, production date YYMMDD and sequence (e.g. “BFT-240101-001”).
Email address of the customer, unique.
textes.Le client qui achète ; vide (NULL) pour: The customer buying; empty (NULL) for a sale at the counter, without an account.
textes.Le lot vendu ; le fromage vendu est celu: The batch sold; the cheese sold is that batch’s cheese.
Date of the sale, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Montant payé, en euros : la quantité ven: Amount paid, in euros: the quantity sold multiplied by the cheese’s price per kilo.
The customer who tasted the cheese.
textes.Date de la dégustation, au format AAAA-M: Date of the tasting, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Note donnée au fromage, un entier de 1 à: Rating given to the cheese, a whole number from 1 to 5 (5 is the best).
textes.Avis écrit du client ; vide (NULL) s’il: The customer’s written opinion; empty (NULL) if they only left a rating.
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris that also ships its cheeses all over Europe. Each cheese in the catalog has its texture, its price per kilo and an availability: 1 when it’s for sale, 0 otherwise. This morning, Julie, at the counter, is preparing the chalkboard in front of the display case. She wants to write on it the cheeses customers can buy today, with their texture and their price per kilo.
textes.son prix au kilo, en euros: its price per kilo, in euros
textes.par prix au kilo, puis par nom: by price per kilo, then by name
textes.Un fromage en vente porte un 1 dans sa d: A cheese for sale has a 1 in its availability: a single condition is enough. To sort two cheeses with the same price, add the name as a second criterion.
textes.Dans quelles régions travaillent les pro: Which regions do the producers work in?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each cheese comes from a producer (a farm, a cheesemaker or a dairy), based in a region of France or elsewhere in Europe. On the shop wall, a big map shows where the cheeses come from. To update it, Margot, the manager, wants the list of all her producers, with their region and their country.
textes.par région, puis par nom du producteur: by region, then by producer name
textes.Aucune condition ici : tous les producte: No condition here: every producer comes out. Only the order matters, and two producers share the same region: the name has to break the tie.
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its cheeses are sorted by texture: soft, hard, semi-hard, stretched curd, or blue. Some aren’t available right now. A blue cheese lover asks Julie, at the counter, for advice. She wants to show him every blue cheese in the catalog, even unavailable ones, so he can compare their prices per kilo.
textes.y compris ceux qui ne sont pas disponibl: including those that aren’t available for sale
textes.par prix au kilo, du plus élevé au plus: by price per kilo, highest first, then by name
textes.Une seule condition sur le type de pâte,: A single condition on the texture, compared exactly with the text “Blue”, capital letter included. Availability doesn’t matter here.
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris that also ships its cheeses all over Europe. Customers can open an account by giving their city, in France or elsewhere. The shop is holding a raclette evening. Nadège, who handles loyalty, wants to invite each registered customer who lives in Paris.

La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its cheeses are sold cut to order: each sale records its date, the weight cut and the amount paid (the weight multiplied by the price per kilo). At the end of the month, Margot, the manager, wants to go over the biggest receipts, those over €15, to check that no weighing mistake slipped in.
textes.les ventes dont le montant payé dépasse: the sales whose amount paid is strictly above €15: a sale of exactly €15 doesn’t count
textes.par date de vente, de la plus récente à: by sale date, most recent first, then by sale ID
textes.Le montant payé doit dépasser 15 € stric: The amount paid must be strictly above €15: a sale of exactly €15 doesn’t count. Then sort the sales from the most recent to the oldest.
textes.Quelles dégustations ont reçu une note d: Which tastings got a rating of at least 4?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Paul runs tastings there: a customer with an account tastes a cheese and gives it a rating from 1 to 5, sometimes with a comment. Before choosing which cheeses to highlight this month, Paul wants to go over, one by one, the tastings that went down well, rated 4 or more.
textes.l’identifiant du fromage goûté: the ID of the cheese tasted
textes.par note, de la plus haute à la plus bas: by rating, highest first, then by cheese ID
textes.« Au moins 4 » garde aussi les notes éga: “At least 4” also keeps the ratings equal to 4. Then sort the tastings from the best rating to the worst.
textes.Quels lots pèsent au moins 3 kilos ?: Which batches weigh at least 3 kilos?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each cheese arrives in batches: pieces made together, with a unique number, a production date and a weight in kilos. Some batches go into the cellar to ripen. Baptiste, the cheese ager, is reorganizing the cold room. He wants to spot the heaviest batches, those of 3 kilos or more, to put them on the bottom shelves.
textes.son poids à la production, en kilos: its weight when produced, in kilos
textes.les lots qui pèsent 3 kilos ou plus: the batches that weigh 3 kilos or more
textes.par poids, du plus lourd au plus léger,: by weight, heaviest first, then by batch number
textes.« Au moins 3 » garde aussi les lots de 3: “At least 3” also keeps the batches of exactly 3 kilos. Several batches have the same weight: their number breaks the tie.
textes.Quelles ventes ont eu lieu depuis le 1er: Which sales have taken place since October 1?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each sale is dated, written year-month-day, with the batch it was cut from, the weight and the amount paid. Margot, the manager, is preparing the accounts for her accountant. She wants to send him every sale made since October 1, 2024, that day included, in the order they took place.
textes.les ventes faites à partir du 1er octobr: the sales made from October 1, 2024, that day included
textes.par date de vente, puis par identifiant: by sale date, then by sale ID
textes.Écrites année-mois-jour, les dates se co: Written year-month-day, dates compare like text. October 1 itself must be kept: choose a comparison that includes it.
textes.Quels types de pâte trouve-t-on au catal: Which textures are in the catalog?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each cheese in the catalog has a texture, which says how it was made: soft, hard, blue… Several cheeses often share the same one. Julie, at the counter, is reorganizing the display case section by section. She wants one section per texture, and needs the list of textures in the catalog, each one only once.
textes.chaque type de pâte du catalogue, une se: each texture in the catalog, only once
textes.Il ne s’agit pas de lister les fromages: The point isn’t to list the cheeses but their textures: each texture must appear only once, even if it comes up for several cheeses.
textes.Combien de fois chaque client a-t-il ach: How many times has each customer bought something?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Customers can open an account, and each of their purchases is recorded on it; some haven’t bought anything yet. Nadège, who handles loyalty, is launching a points card. First she wants to know how many times each registered customer has already bought something, with 0 for those who haven’t bought anything.
textes.son nombre de ventes, 0 s’il n’en a aucu: their number of sales, 0 if they have none
textes.tous les clients, y compris ceux qui n’o: every customer, including those who haven’t bought anything yet
textes.par nombre de ventes, du plus grand au p: by number of sales, largest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Pars de tous les clients, même ceux sans: Start from every customer, even those without a purchase, then count their sales. Counting the rows would give 1 to a customer without a purchase: count the sales actually found instead.
textes.Quelles régions génèrent le plus de chif: Which regions bring in the most revenue?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each sale is taken from a batch, each batch comes from a cheese, and each cheese from a producer based in a region. Every sale counts, even those made at the counter to a customer without an account. Margot, the manager, is preparing the next regional produce fair: she wants to know which production regions bring her the most, with all of a region’s producers together.
textes.la région du producteur (une ligne par r: the producer’s region (one row per region, all its producers together)
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the amounts paid for this region’s cheeses, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les régions qui ont au moins u: only the regions with at least one sale
textes.par chiffre d’affaires, du plus élevé au: by revenue, highest first, then by region
textes.Toutes les ventes comptent, y compris ce: Every sale counts, including those made at the counter, without a customer account.
textes.Remonte de chaque vente jusqu’à sa régio: Go back from each sale to its region: through the batch, then the cheese, then the producer. Then add up the amounts region by region, not producer by producer.
textes.Quels fromages ont une note moyenne supé: Which cheeses have an average rating above 4?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. During in-store tastings, customers taste a cheese and give it a rating from 1 to 5. Paul, who runs these tastings, is preparing the “Customer favorites” board. He’s looking for the cheeses whose average rating, over all their tastings, is above 4; an average of exactly 4 doesn’t count.
textes.sa note moyenne sur toutes ses dégustati: its average rating over all its tastings, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les fromages dont la note moyenne dépass: the cheeses whose average rating is strictly above 4: an average of exactly 4 doesn’t count
textes.par note moyenne, de la plus haute à la: by average rating, highest first, then by name
textes.Calcule la moyenne des notes de chaque f: Calculate each cheese’s average rating. The threshold applies to that average, not to each rating: it can only be checked once the average is calculated.
textes.Quels producteurs fabriquent plus de 2 f: Which producers make more than 2 cheeses?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each cheese in the catalog, available or not, comes from a producer, and some producers supply several. Margot, the manager, is renegotiating her contracts. First she wants to spot the producers who supply the most cheeses to her catalog: more than 2 each, so at least 3.
textes.son nombre de fromages au catalogue, dis: its number of cheeses in the catalog, available or not
textes.les producteurs qui ont plus de 2 fromag: the producers with more than 2 cheeses in the catalog, so at least 3
textes.par nombre de fromages, du plus grand au: by number of cheeses, largest first, then by name
textes.Compte les fromages de chaque producteur: Count each producer’s cheeses. The threshold of 2 applies to that count: it can only be checked once the count is done.
textes.Quels fromages ont été vendus plus de 2: Which cheeses have been sold more than 2 times?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each sale is a piece cut from a batch, and each batch comes from a cheese; a sale only knows its batch. Every sale counts, even those at the counter, without a customer account. Margot, the manager, is preparing her orders to the producers: she wants the cheeses sold more than 2 times, all batches combined, to order them in larger quantities.
textes.son nombre de ventes, tous lots confondu: its number of sales, all batches combined
textes.les fromages qui ont plus de 2 ventes, d: the cheeses with more than 2 sales, so at least 3
textes.par nombre de ventes, du plus grand au p: by number of sales, largest first, then by name
textes.Passe par le lot de chaque vente pour re: Go through each sale’s batch to find its cheese. Then count the sales cheese by cheese, not batch by batch, and keep those above 2.
textes.Quels clients ont dépensé plus de 50 € ?: Which customers have spent more than €50?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. The purchases of customers with an account are recorded in their name, each with the amount paid. Nadège, who handles loyalty, wants to thank the best customers by giving them a cheese platter: those who have spent more than €50 in total at the shop; exactly €50 isn’t enough.
textes.son total dépensé : la somme des montant: their total spent: the sum of the amounts paid for their purchases, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les clients dont le total dépensé dépass: the customers whose total spent is strictly above €50: exactly €50 isn’t enough
textes.par total dépensé, du plus élevé au plus: by total spent, highest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Calcule d’abord le total dépensé par cha: First calculate the total spent by each customer. The €50 threshold applies to that total, not to each purchase: it can only be checked once the sum is done.
textes.Quelles ventes dépassent le montant moye: Which sales are above the average amount?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. For each sale, the amount paid is known, from a small piece to a whole wheel. The average ticket is the average amount of all sales. Margot, the manager, wants to spot the purchases that stand out: the sales whose amount is above this average ticket.
textes.les ventes dont le montant payé dépasse: the sales whose amount paid is strictly above the average amount of all sales
textes.par montant payé, du plus élevé au plus: by amount paid, highest first, then by sale ID
textes.Il te faut d’abord une seule valeur : la: First you need a single value: the average amount of all sales. Then compare each sale with this average, calculated separately.
textes.Quels types de pâte rapportent le plus ?: Which textures bring in the most?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its cheeses are sorted by texture and sold by weight: each sale records the kilos sold and the amount paid. A sale only knows its batch, which leads to the cheese. Julie, at the counter, is rearranging the display case. For each texture, she wants to compare the kilos sold and the money taken in, to give more room to the textures that sell best.
textes.le poids vendu, en kilos : la somme des: the weight sold, in kilos: the sum of the quantities sold, rounded to two decimal places
textes.le chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mon: the revenue: the sum of the amounts paid, rounded to two decimal places
textes.par chiffre d’affaires, du plus élevé au: by revenue, highest first, then by texture
textes.Remonte de chaque vente jusqu’au fromage: Go back from each sale to the cheese, through its batch, to find the texture. Then do two sums per texture: the kilos and the amounts.
textes.Combien de fromages chaque producteur a-: How many cheeses does each producer have in the catalog?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each cheese in the catalog, available or not, comes from a producer; some producers have no cheese in it right now. Before renewing the contracts, Margot, the manager, wants to review each producer’s place in her catalog, with 0 for those who have no cheese in it.
textes.son nombre de fromages au catalogue, dis: its number of cheeses in the catalog, available or not, 0 if it has none
textes.tous les producteurs, y compris ceux qui: every producer, including those with no cheese in the catalog
textes.Pars de tous les producteurs, même ceux: Start from every producer, even those without a cheese, then count their cheeses. Counting the rows would give 1 to a producer without a cheese: count the cheeses actually found instead.
textes.Quels fromages n’ont jamais été dégustés: Which cheeses have never been tasted?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. During in-store tastings, customers taste a cheese and give it a rating; tastings are stored separately, each with its cheese. Paul, who runs them, is preparing his next workshop. He wants to introduce the cheeses nobody has tasted yet, even those that aren’t available for sale.
textes.les fromages qui n’ont aucune dégustatio: the cheeses that have no tasting
textes.Pars de tous les fromages et cherche leu: Start from every cheese and look for their tastings. Also keep the ones for which nothing is found, then keep only those.
textes.Comment se répartissent les notes de dég: How are the tasting ratings distributed?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each in-store tasting ends with a rating from 1 to 5 given to the cheese. Nadège, who handles loyalty and the website, is preparing the “Customer reviews” page. She wants to show how many tastings received each rating, and what share of all tastings it represents, as a percentage.
textes.le nombre de dégustations qui ont reçu c: the number of tastings that received this rating
textes.sa part dans l’ensemble des dégustations: its share of all tastings, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les notes données au moins une: only the ratings given at least once
textes.Compte les dégustations note par note. P: Count the tastings rating by rating. For the share, you also need the total number of tastings: divide the first by the second. Bring a decimal number into the division to keep the decimals.
textes.Quel fromage domine les ventes de chaque: Which cheese leads the sales in each region?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its cheeses come from producers based in several regions, and each sale, taken from a batch, brings in the amount the customer paid. Julie, at the counter, is preparing the “Tour of the regions” display. In each production region, she wants to highlight the cheese that brings the shop the most, and any that would be tied with it.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the amounts paid for this cheese, rounded to two decimal places
textes.dans chaque région, seulement le fromage: in each region, only the cheese with the biggest revenue, and any tied with it
textes.seulement les régions et les fromages qu: only the regions and cheeses with at least one sale
textes.par région, puis par nom du fromage: by region, then by cheese name
textes.Calcule d’abord ce que rapporte chaque f: First calculate what each cheese brings in, with its region. Then rank the cheeses within each region, and keep only first place, ties included.
textes.Quels clients dépensent plus que la moye: Which customers spend more than the average for their city?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris that also ships its cheeses all over Europe. Its customers with an account come from several cities, and their purchases are recorded in their name. Nadège, who handles loyalty, is choosing ambassadors in each city. City by city, she’s looking for the customers who spend more than the average of the customers from their city who have already bought something.
textes.la moyenne de sa ville : la moyenne des: their city’s average: the average of the totals spent by the customers from this city with at least one purchase, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les clients dont le total dépensé dépass: the customers whose total spent is strictly above their city’s average
textes.par ville, puis par total dépensé, du pl: by city, then by total spent, highest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Deux étapes : le total dépensé par chaqu: Two steps: the total spent by each customer, then the average of these totals for each city, not the average of the sales. Link each customer to their city’s average to compare.
textes.Quels fromages dépassent le chiffre d’af: Which cheeses are above the average revenue?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Some cheeses sell much more than others; each sale is taken from a batch that leads to the cheese. Margot, the manager, wants to know which ones drive her sales up. She compares what each cheese brings in with what a cheese sold at least once brings in on average.
textes.les fromages dont le chiffre d’affaires: the cheeses whose revenue is strictly above the average revenue per cheese
textes.par chiffre d’affaires, du plus élevé au: by revenue, highest first, then by name
textes.Le chiffre d’affaires moyen est la moyen: The average revenue is the average of the revenues of only the cheeses sold at least once.
textes.Deux étapes : le chiffre d’affaires de c: Two steps: each cheese’s revenue, then the average of these figures, a single value. The average is taken over the cheeses’ totals, not over the sales one by one.
textes.Quels producteurs dépassent le chiffre d: Which producers are above the average revenue?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each producer supplies one or more cheeses, and the sales of these cheeses, taken from their batches, make up part of the shop’s revenue. The shop is holding an open day with its producers. Margot, the manager, wants to invite those whose cheeses bring in more than the average of the producers who have sold at least once.
textes.son chiffre d’affaires : la somme des mo: its revenue: the sum of the amounts paid for its cheeses, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les producteurs dont le chiffre d’affair: the producers whose revenue is strictly above the average revenue per producer
textes.Le chiffre d’affaires moyen est la moyen: The average revenue is the average of the revenues of only the producers with at least one sale.
textes.Additionne d’abord les ventes de chaque: First add up each producer’s sales, going through the batch then the cheese. Then calculate the average of these totals, a single value, and compare each producer with it.
textes.Quel est le classement des fromages par: How do the cheeses rank by quantity sold?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its cheeses are sold by weight: each sale, taken from a batch, records the kilos sold. Baptiste, the cheese ager, ripens in the cellar those that need it, and he adjusts his orders of cheeses to ripen. He wants the cheeses’ leaderboard by kilos sold, from the best-selling to the least, with their rank; every sale counts, counter included.
textes.sa quantité vendue, en kilos : la somme: its quantity sold, in kilos: the sum of the quantities of its sales, rounded to two decimal places
textes.son rang : 1 pour la plus grande quantit: its rank: 1 for the largest quantity, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.seulement les fromages vendus au moins u: only the cheeses sold at least once
textes.par rang, puis par nom du fromage: by rank, then by cheese name
textes.Additionne les kilos vendus de chaque fr: Add up the kilos sold of each cheese, going through each sale’s batch. Then give a rank based on that total: two tied cheeses share the same rank, and the next rank skips a place.
textes.Quels clients ont acheté tous les types: Which customers have bought every texture?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its catalog has five textures: soft, hard, semi-hard, stretched curd and blue. Nadège, who handles loyalty, wants to award the “Great explorer” badge to the customers who have tried the whole range: those who have bought at least one cheese of each of the 5 textures.
textes.les clients qui ont acheté au moins un f: the customers who have bought at least one cheese of each texture in the catalog (there are 5)
textes.Pour chaque client, compte ses types de: For each customer, count their different textures, going back from the sale to the cheese through the batch. Compare that number with the number of different textures in the catalog, calculated separately.
textes.Quels clients ont acheté le même fromage: Which customers have bought the same cheese more than 2 times?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Some customers with an account have their favorite cheese and always come back for it; each purchase is taken from a batch, and the same cheese has several batches. Paul, the cheesemonger who runs the tastings, wants to thank these regulars: those who have bought the same cheese more than 2 times. He’ll keep a piece of the next wheel for them.
textes.le nombre de ventes de ce fromage à ce c: the number of sales of this cheese to this customer, all batches combined
textes.seulement les couples client et fromage: only the customer and cheese pairs with more than 2 sales, so at least 3
textes.par nombre de ventes, du plus grand au p: by number of sales, largest first, then by customer last name, then by first name, then by cheese name
textes.Il faut former des couples client et fro: You need to form customer and cheese pairs, all batches combined, then count the sales of each pair. Keep only the pairs above 2.
textes.Combien de fromages différents ont été v: How many different cheeses have been sold?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its catalog has many cheeses, but not all of them have been sold yet; a cheese has several batches, and each sale is taken from a batch. Margot, the manager, is adding an indicator to her dashboard: how many different cheeses from the catalog have already found a buyer at least once.
textes.le nombre de fromages différents vendus: the number of different cheeses sold at least once
textes.Un fromage vendu plusieurs fois, même da: A cheese sold several times, even from different batches, only counts once.
textes.Passe par les lots pour relier les vente: Go through the batches to link the sales to their cheese. Then count the different cheeses with at least one sale: a cheese sold several times, or from several batches, only counts once.
textes.Quels clients achètent plus de 2 types d: Which customers buy more than 2 textures?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Its cheeses are sorted by texture, and some customers like variety. Nadège, who handles loyalty, writes the “Cheese curious” newsletter. She wants to spot the customers who have bought cheeses of more than 2 different textures, so at least 3.
textes.son nombre de types de pâte différents a: their number of different textures bought
textes.les clients qui ont acheté plus de 2 typ: the customers who have bought more than 2 different textures, so at least 3
textes.par nombre de types de pâte, du plus gra: by number of textures, largest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Remonte de chaque vente jusqu’au type de: Go back from each sale to the cheese’s texture, through the batch. For each customer, count the different textures: two purchases of hard cheese only count once.
textes.Quels fromages se vendent plus cher au k: Which cheeses sell for more per kilo than average?
textes.La Meule d’Or est une fromagerie artisan: La Meule d’Or is an artisan cheese shop in Paris. Each sale records the kilos sold and the amount paid. A cheese’s average price per kilo is all the money taken in for it divided by all its kilos sold; the shop’s is calculated the same way over all sales. Before reviewing her prices, Margot, the manager, wants to spot the cheeses that sell for more per kilo than the shop as a whole.
textes.son prix moyen au kilo : le total payé p: its average price per kilo: the total paid for this cheese divided by the total of its kilos sold, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les fromages dont ce prix moyen dépasse: the cheeses whose average price is strictly above that of all sales together
textes.par prix moyen au kilo, du plus élevé au: by average price per kilo, highest first, then by name
textes.Le prix moyen de toutes les ventes réuni: The average price of all sales together is calculated the same way: their total paid divided by their total kilos, not as an average of prices per kilo.
textes.Pour chaque fromage, divise le total pay: For each cheese, divide the total paid by the total kilos. The threshold is the same division done over all sales together, not an average of prices per kilo.
